chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Aḥmad ibn Ashyam narrated, saying:

I asked Abū al-Ḥasan, peace be upon him, about a man whose wife had become pure from her menstruation, and he said, “So-and-so is divorced,” while people were hearing his words, but he did not say to them, “Bear witness.” Does the divorce take effect upon her?
He said: “Yes, this is testimony. Would you leave her suspended?”
ai.seo_question: Does a divorce take effect if people hear it but the husband does not explicitly tell them to bear witness?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning divorce and the sufficiency of public hearing as testimony when the divorce formula is pronounced. The Imam عليه السلام affirms that if people heard the statement, this counts as testimony even without the explicit command to witness, preventing the woman from being left in uncertainty.
